title: Warranty Repair Issue Tracking Log
use_case: Use the issue tracking log during trade warranty repair dispatch and verification when the warranty repair record must identify original work order, installed component, location, completion date, warranty term, customer, and prior callbacks. Complete the applicable handoff for repair verification, customer acceptance, coverage disposition, recurrence action, costs, and warranty-record update.
